name: lightningcss
description: Stand-in for 'lightningcss', which Vite 8 lists as a dependency. Its licence is MPL-2.0, which this project does not allow (PROJECT.md section 3). The site does not use it: astro.config.mjs tells Vite to handle CSS with PostCSS and not to minify CSS. If anything ever calls it, the build stops with an error.
